newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Pigs not far from equalling Belgians - in number.
newsitem.headline: Pigs not far from equalling Belgians - in number.

text.p: In terms of numbers, pigs are not far from being equal to people in Belgium, and with good reason: pork is a key export.
Provisional data published on Tuesday showed the pig population grew by 270,000 to 7.4 million in 1996, closing in on the human population of 10 million people.

Flanders, in Belgium's northern half, is home to 96 percent of the country's pigs, making it the most densely-populated part of the European Union in pig terms after neighbouring southern Netherlands.
Pork exports were worth 60 billion Belgian francs ($1.74 billion) last year, up 18 percent from 1995.
